terms.title: Terms & conditions
terms.description: How the Divine Souls By Priya site may be used, and how a note on the page differs from reaching Priya.

hero.title:
Terms &
conditions.
hero.body: These words explain how this site may be used. They describe the pages as they work now. They are not a booking, and they are not a promise of a result.

sections.title: Agreement to these terms
paragraphs: Divine Souls By Priya is a healing practice in Dehradun, India. Priya guides the sessions, the courses, and the charged pieces described on this site. The site is the public face of that practice. It is not a shop, and it does not take payment.

By opening these pages you agree to read them as they are written. If you do not agree, leave the site. Continuing to read, to follow a link, or to type into a form means you accept these terms for that visit.

A session, a course place, or a charged piece is arranged with Priya herself. These terms do not create that arrangement. The arrangement begins only when Priya agrees to it, by phone, by email, or on WhatsApp.

These words were written for the site as it works on 12 October 2026. If a page changes, the terms on the site at the time of your visit are the ones that apply. You can print or save a copy for yourself.

sections.title: 1. The practice and the site
paragraphs: The site describes holistic healing, tarot and divination, Vedic healing, ritual and candle work, meditation, courses, and charged pieces such as crystals, healing kits, and ritual tools. It is written so a person can understand the work before they write to Priya.
The practice is based in Dehradun. Some sessions can also be offered at a distance. The site says so where that is true. It does not publish a street address, a price list, or a checkout.

You can reach Priya in the ways the site already shows: call +91 7668648224, email priyasinha1809@gmail.com, or write on WhatsApp at the same number. Instagram and Facebook are public pages of the practice. The map link opens the Google place for Divine Souls.

sections.title: 2. What the site does not do
paragraphs: The site does not sell a session, a course, or a product by itself. It does not show a price, take a card, or send an order. A button that says book, enroll, enquire, or submit only confirms, on that same page, the words you typed.
Nothing from those forms is stored as a message to Priya, and nothing is sent on to her. If you need her to read it, call, email, or use WhatsApp. The success line on the form says the same thing.
The site does not ask you to create an account, choose a password, or sign in. There is no public comment box, no forum, and no place for you to post a review onto the site.

sections.title: 3. A note left on a form
paragraphs: Book, enroll, enquire, and contact forms are there so you can set down a name, a number, and what you have in mind. While the page is open, those words stay in the browser on your device. When you leave or refresh the page, they are gone.
Do not type anything into a form that you need Priya to receive. Use the form only as a draft on the page, or skip it and write to her directly.

If you do type a note, you are responsible for what it says. Do not include another person’s private story unless you have the right to share it, and do not include anything you are not willing to see on your own screen.

sections.title: 4. Sessions, courses, and pieces
paragraphs: A healing session, a reading, a course, or a charged piece is personal. Priya decides, with you, whether the work is a fit and what form it should take. The pages describe the kinds of work. They do not guarantee a date, a method, or an outcome.

Healing and divination are not a medical diagnosis and not a substitute for a doctor, a counsellor, or emergency care. If you are in danger, or someone else is, contact local emergency services. Do not wait for a reply from this site.

Courses described here are taught by Priya. A place on a course is not reserved by the enroll form. Products described here are charged pieces from the practice. An enquire button does not reserve a piece and does not start a payment.

sections.title: 5. Words, pictures, and the name
paragraphs: The writing, photographs, illustrations, and layout on this site belong to the practice, or are used with permission. The name Divine Souls By Priya, and the mark in the navigation, identify the practice. You may not copy them onto another site, a product, or an advertisement as if they were yours.
You may read the pages, and you may share a link to a page, for a personal reason. You may not copy the pages into a collection, a database, or a product, and you may not scrape them with a script.
If you want to use a photograph, a passage, or the name for anything beyond a private link, write to priyasinha1809@gmail.com and wait for a yes. Silence is not permission.

sections.title: 6. What you agree not to do
paragraphs: Use the site to read about the practice and, if you choose, to reach Priya. Do not use it for anything else. In particular, you agree not to:
points: Break the site, overload it, or try to get into a part that is not a public page.
Copy the code, the text, or the pictures in order to build a competing site or a product.
Pretend to be Priya, Divine Souls, or another person writing from this practice.
Send a script, a robot, or a scraper to pull names, numbers, or page text.
Upload or transmit a virus, or anything meant to interrupt the pages.
Use the phone number, the email, or WhatsApp to harass, threaten, or mislead Priya or anyone else.
Collect addresses from the site in order to send unsolicited mail.
Frame the site inside another site so that it looks like someone else’s work.
Remove a credit, a copyright line, or the handcrafted note in the footer and present the pages as unmarked.

sections.title: 7. Messages you send to Priya
paragraphs: A call, an email, or a WhatsApp message is a private note to Priya. It is not published on this site. She may keep it for as long as she needs in order to answer you and to carry out the work you asked about.
Do not send anything you do not have the right to send. Do not send another person’s medical detail, a private photograph, or a story that is not yours to share, unless they have agreed.

Priya may decline a session, a course place, or a piece. She may also stop a conversation that is abusive or that asks her to do something the practice does not offer. These terms do not force her to accept every request.

sections.title: 8. Words already on the site
paragraphs: Some pages include words from people who have sat with Priya. Those lines were given as reviews elsewhere, including on Google, and are shown here with the person’s name as it was published. They are not a form you can fill in on this site.
A review is that person’s account. It is not a promise that your session will feel the same. The practice does not edit a person’s words in order to invent a result.

sections.title: 9. Links that leave
paragraphs: Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, Gmail, the phone link, and Google Maps open those other services. What you do there follows their terms and their privacy rules, not only these pages.

A link is not an endorsement of every post on that service. The practice is responsible for the pages it writes here, and for the accounts it names. It is not responsible for a comment a stranger leaves on a social network.

sections.title: 10. Changes, mistakes, and time offline
paragraphs: Pages can be corrected when a line is wrong, a course changes, or a description needs to be clearer. A correction can appear without a separate email to every reader, because the site does not keep a mailing list.
The site can be unreachable while it is updated or while the host has a fault. There is no promise that every page will open at every moment. If a page is down, call or email Priya.
The site does not list prices. If a number ever appears by mistake, it is not an offer. Ask Priya before you rely on it.

sections.title: 11. Privacy and cookies
paragraphs: How a note is handled, and what the site does not keep, is written on the Privacy Policy. What the browser may store, and what this site does not set, is written on the Cookie Policy. Those two pages are part of these terms. If they disagree with a casual line elsewhere, the legal page is the one to follow.

sections.title: 12. No promised outcome
paragraphs: The pages are offered as they are, so you can read about the practice. They are not a warranty that a session will change a particular part of your life, that a course will qualify you for a title, or that a charged piece will act in a particular way.

To the extent the law allows, the practice is not liable for a loss that comes only from reading the site, from a form that never left your browser, or from a third-party page you opened from a link. A session you later agree with Priya is a separate conversation, and its limits belong in that conversation, not in a silent checkout.
Nothing here takes away a right you have under the law of India that cannot be waived.

sections.title: 13. The place of the practice
paragraphs: The practice is in Dehradun, India. These terms are written for that practice and for this site. They are not a filing with a court, and they do not name an arbitrator. If you have a complaint about the site, start by writing or calling Priya, and say which page you mean.
If a line in these terms cannot be enforced, the rest of the terms still stand. Not insisting on a line today does not erase it.

sections.title: 14. How to ask
paragraphs: For a question about these terms, or about a page, reach Priya directly. The forms on the site will not carry the question to her.
points: Divine Souls By Priya, Dehradun, India
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 7668648224
Email: priyasinha1809@gmail.com

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: What the Divine Souls By Priya site handles, what the forms do not send, and how to reach Priya about a note.

hero.title:
Privacy
Policy.
hero.body: This notice says what the site does with a visit and a note, and what it does not keep. It matches the site as it works now.

sections.title: Summary
paragraphs: Read this first if you only need the short version. The longer sections below say the same things in more detail.
points: Book, enroll, enquire, and contact forms confirm on the page. They do not store what you type, and they do not send it to Priya.
The site does not ask you to make an account, and it does not run an advertising or analytics tracker.
A call, an email, or a WhatsApp message goes through those services. Write only what you are ready for Priya to read there.
Instagram, Facebook, and Google Maps are other sites. This site does not follow you after you leave.
There is no cookie banner, because this site does not set an advertising or analytics cookie. The Cookie Policy says more.
If you want a note disregarded, ask Priya by phone or email. There is no separate portal on this site, because the site does not hold the note.

sections.title: 1. Who this notice is about
paragraphs: This notice is about the website of Divine Souls By Priya, a healing practice in Dehradun, India. It covers the pages on this site: home, about, services, courses, products, contact, and these legal pages.
It does not cover Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, Gmail, your phone company, or Google Maps, except to say that a link from here opens them. Those services have their own notices.

Priya is the person to ask. There is no separate data-protection office and no company registration number published on this site, because none is claimed here. Contact her at +91 7668648224 or priyasinha1809@gmail.com.

sections.title: 2. What the forms do
paragraphs: The contact form, the service booking form, the course enroll form, and the product enquire form all behave the same way. You can type a name, a number, a choice, and a message. When you submit, the page shows a confirmation. That confirmation is the end of the form.

The words are not written into a database on this site. They are not emailed. They are not added to a spreadsheet. They live in the page while it is open. Leaving the page or refreshing it clears them.

Because of that, do not use a form for anything urgent or anything you need Priya to see. Call, email, or WhatsApp her. The confirmation text tells you the same thing, and names the phone number and the email.

sections.title: 3. What you send by phone, email, or WhatsApp
paragraphs: If you call +91 7668648224, email priyasinha1809@gmail.com, or open WhatsApp to that number, you are contacting Priya through that service. She may read the message, reply, and keep it while she is working with you.

Send only what you want her to know. A healing conversation can include personal detail. You choose what to say. She does not pull that detail out of the website, because the website does not have it.

Those services may keep their own copies under their own rules. This site cannot delete a WhatsApp chat from Meta’s systems, or an email from your mail provider. If you want Priya to disregard a message she received, ask her directly.

sections.title: 4. What this site does not collect
paragraphs: The site does not ask for an account, a password, a payment card, or a government identity number. It does not run a newsletter signup. It does not sell a list of visitors.
It does not use an advertising tracker, a marketing pixel, or an analytics product that follows you from page to page for ads. The Cookie Policy is the longer note on that point.
Testimonials on the site are lines already published by the people named there. The site does not offer a box for a new public review, and it does not collect a review score.

The company that delivers the pages may keep ordinary technical logs, such as the time a page was requested, so the site can be served. This practice does not use those logs to build an advertising profile, and this notice does not pretend to list a retention period the host has not published here.

sections.title: 5. Who else sees a note
paragraphs: A note typed only into a form on this site is not shared, because it is not sent. A message you send Priya by phone, email, or WhatsApp is for her, so she can answer and, if you both agree, do the work.

She does not sell that message and does not pass it to an advertiser. She may need to refer you to emergency care, or to answer a lawful request, if the law requires it. That is the limit of this section. There is no routine sharing with a marketing partner, because there is no marketing list.

sections.title: 6. Cookies and tracking
paragraphs: This site does not set an advertising cookie or an analytics cookie, and it does not show a consent banner for one. Your browser can still remember an ordinary visit in its own way. The Cookie Policy explains that, and explains the other sites a link can open.
The site does not respond to a Do Not Track signal with a special setting, because it is not running a tracker that such a signal would switch off.

sections.title: 7. How long a note lasts
paragraphs: A form note lasts only as long as the page is open. It is not kept for a year, or for any other period, on this site.

A message Priya actually receives, by phone, email, or WhatsApp, lasts as long as she needs it for the conversation and the work, and as long as she is required to keep it. If you want her to delete what she can delete, ask her. Messages that live inside WhatsApp, Gmail, or a phone carrier follow those services as well.

sections.title: 8. Care with what you send
paragraphs: Because the site does not store the form, there is no site archive to protect. The risk is the opposite: people sometimes think a form has been delivered when it has not. Read the confirmation before you close the page.
When you write to Priya on WhatsApp or email, use the care you would use for any private message. Do not send account passwords, card numbers, or someone else’s private records.

sections.title: 9. Your choices
paragraphs: You can use the site without typing anything. You can leave a form blank. You can reach Priya only by the channel you choose.

You can ask her what she still has from a conversation, and you can ask her to delete what she is able to delete. There is no button on this site that edits a stored profile, because the site does not keep one.
If you are writing from outside India, know that Priya reads messages in Dehradun. Sending her an email or a WhatsApp message sends that message to her there, through the service you chose.

sections.title: 10. Children
paragraphs: The site is written for adults who are arranging their own session, course, or piece. It does not ask for a child’s name, age, or story, and it does not offer a children’s account.

If a young person wants to read the site, they should do it with a parent or guardian. Do not send a child’s private detail through a form. The form would not deliver it, and it should not be typed there in any case.

sections.title: 11. Changes to this notice
paragraphs: If the site later stores a form, adds a tracker, or starts a mailing list, this notice will be rewritten first, and the date at the top will change. Until that happens, the summary above is the practice.
The date of these words is 12 October 2026.

sections.title: 12. How to ask about this notice
paragraphs: Questions about this notice go to Priya, not to a form on the page.
points: Divine Souls By Priya, Dehradun, India
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 7668648224
Email: priyasinha1809@gmail.com

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.description: The Divine Souls By Priya site does not set advertising or analytics cookies, and this page says what a browser may still do.

hero.title:
Cookie
Policy.
hero.body: This page says what a cookie is, what this site does not set, and what happens when you open Instagram, Facebook, WhatsApp, or the map.

sections.title: 1. What this page covers
paragraphs: This policy is about the website of Divine Souls By Priya, the healing practice in Dehradun. It was written on 12 October 2026, for the site as it works now.
It sits beside the Privacy Policy. The privacy page is about notes and messages. This page is about small files and similar storage a browser can keep.

sections.title: 2. What a cookie is
paragraphs: A cookie is a small file a site can ask your browser to keep. Some cookies remember a choice you made. Some last only until you close the browser. Some last longer and are used to recognise a browser on a later visit, including for advertising.

Sites can also use similar storage inside the browser, such as local storage. On this site, a form holds what you type in the page itself. That is not written into a cookie, and it is cleared when you leave or refresh.

sections.title: 3. What this site sets
paragraphs: This site does not set an advertising cookie. It does not set an analytics cookie. It does not use a cookie to remember you for a mailing list, a shopping cart, or an account, because it has none of those.
There is no cookie banner. A banner is for a choice about a cookie the site wants to set. There is no such choice to offer.
Your browser can still keep its own ordinary record of a visit, according to the settings you chose in the browser. That record is the browser’s, not a tracker added by these pages.

sections.title: 4. What you can do in the browser
paragraphs: You can block or delete cookies in the browser you use. The control sits in that browser’s settings, not on this site. Blocking cookies should not stop you from reading these pages, because the pages do not depend on an account cookie.
If a page ever failed to open because of a strict browser setting, call or email Priya. The content of the practice is not locked behind a cookie.

sections.title: 5. Other sites a link can open
paragraphs: Some links leave this site. They open a service that has its own cookies and its own policy. This site does not control those cookies and does not read them.
points: Instagram and Facebook, for the public pages of the practice.
WhatsApp, when you choose to message +91 7668648224.
Your email app or Gmail, when you write to priyasinha1809@gmail.com.
Google Maps, when you open the place link for Dehradun.
A phone call, which is your carrier, not a cookie.

sections.title: 6. If a cookie is added later
paragraphs: If a later tool on this site needs a cookie, this page will say what it is, why it is there, and how long it lasts, before that tool is used. An advertising or analytics cookie will not be added in silence.
Until that edit, the practice is the one in the sections above.

sections.title: 7. How to ask
paragraphs: A question about this policy can go straight to Priya. The forms on the site will not deliver it.
points: Divine Souls By Priya, Dehradun, India
Phone and WhatsApp: +91 7668648224
Email: priyasinha1809@gmail.com
